title: Config Read State Schema
description: Sub-state for config_read_attest MCP tool — tracks whether the agent has read the 3 mandatory config files (agent config, opencode.json, project.config.json) per session before being allowed to write.

session_id.description: OpenCode session ID that completed config read attestation

attested_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the config read attestation was completed

files.description: List of 3 config file paths that were verified as read
